title: Gallows' Corner

[[Image:Gallows' Corner.jpg|thumb|Gallows' Corner]]
'''Gallows' Corner''' is a crossroads in the [[Alterac Mountains]], close to the [[Ruins of Alterac]]. This area is held by [[ogre]]s who patrol the area around the ruined tower.
